$comment: version 1.0.0 — host_static_pages embedded auth (postMessage success envelope)
title: Embedded Auth — postMessage success envelope (v1)
description: Wire shape posted by the embed-auth popup back to its opener via `window.opener.postMessage(envelope, requestedOrigin)` after a successful auth flow. The widget verifies `event.origin === blocksApiOrigin`, asserts `event.data.type === 'blocks-auth-success'` and `event.data.version === 1`, asserts `event.data.state` matches the nonce the widget generated before opening the popup (per `embed-popup-request.schema.json`), and then routes `jwt`, `refreshToken`, `expiresAt`, `agentIds`, `agents`, `orgId`, and `userId` into the SDK. v1 envelopes are intentionally exact (`additionalProperties: false`); see the README for the versioning principle.

state.description: Cryptographically random nonce echoed from the popup request. Minimum 22 base64 chars (~128 bits) or 32 hex chars (128 bits).

jwt.description: Short-lived consumer JWT for the requested agents.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token consumed by POST /api/v1/auth/embed/refresh and revoked by POST /api/v1/auth/embed/revoke.

expiresAt.description: JWT expiry as Unix epoch milliseconds.

agentIds.description: Agent UUIDs the JWT covers. 25-agent cap is shared with `embed-popup-request.schema.json`, `embed-refresh-response.schema.json`, and `internal/blocks-config.schema.json`.

id.description: Agent UUID. MUST appear in `agentIds` as well.

billingMode.description: Snapshot billing mode at popup time. The SDK uses this to pick free vs paid call paths without a separate registry GET.

agents.description: Per-agent metadata for the requested agents. Order is not significant; uniqueness is enforced.

orgId.description: Org UUID the JWT acts under. Forced to the private agent's org if any requested agent is private; otherwise either the user's only org or the org chosen by the popup picker (see HOST_PAGES_PLAN §5.3).

userId.description: User UUID that completed the popup flow.
